name: WiseTech Global Limited
summary: WiseTech Global Limited operates as a developer and provider of software solutions for logistics, global trade, and supply chain industries in the Americas, the Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates in two segments, WTG ex. e2open and e2open. The company offers various software solutions for forwarding and customs, landside logistics, digital documents, TMS, specialist WMS, carrier and rates, and enterprise. Its software enables logistics service providers to execute logistics transactions and manage operations on one database across multiple users, functions, offices, corporations, currencies, countries, and languages.
